(531)thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gtong lugs/rtsa gtor bskang chog gtor ma zhi khro ltar/dkar bgegs/chad brtan/cha gsum/tshogs gnyis/gsol kaganas

tei:div.tei:p: thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gtong lugs/ rtsa gtor bskang chog gtor ma zhi khro ltar/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan/ cha gsum/ tshogs gnyis/ gsol ka gnas 'dren la zhi sbyong gsum/ drag sbyong zan gong gsum/ chang bu gsum/ rigs drug mar me lan chags dkris pa drug zas bsngo/ gtso las bum pa/ me long yig drug dang*/ thub drug sa bon drug bcas/ tsakli/ bdag 'jug la gsang thod/ rig tsaka me long*/ shel rdo/ gzungs thag sngags bye/ yungs thun sogs 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la/ sems bskyed sdom chog 'dzam gling yan/ na mo lo ki shwa ra= rig stong= dung chen/ rol mo byin rlabs che chung gang mos/ rang gi snying ga'i= 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i= skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ sems bskyed lan gsum/ yan bdun/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ dkar bgegs spyi ltar/ dung chen/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis 'jog yod kyis rol tshigs rigs 'dus ltar la/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs/ lha bskyed/ spyen 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ hoḥ mchod pa/ gdangs/ shabta= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā dkar rgya bcad/ dung sbrel/ thing gcig (Musical notes and signs here) sum gnyis/ hrīḥ khyad par= dha tu pū tsa hoḥ sum gcig dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā sum gnyis/ bstod pa/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ phaṭaḥdzaḥ zhes pas dzapra khang dbye/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po= ma ṇi khri gcig 'phags pa'i thugs las 'od 'phros pasaḥ rdze btsun= la bstim tshe bsring gyuraḥ ma ṇi la ta re btags pa brgya/ 'phags pa'i= 'od zer= gsham (532) sbyar/ 'phags pa'i= rig byed= ma ṇi la gsham sbyar brgya/ 'phags pa'i= nor rgyun= ma ṇi la gsham sbyar brgya/ las sbyor bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i= ma ṇi/ yig brgya/ da ha sbrel ba brgya/ bde bar gshegs pa= mi za'oḥ bum sgrub/ swa bhā wa= bum pa mi dmigs= yo ga shabta= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ hrīḥ chos dbyings spros pa= rigs lnga spyi phyag gis bstod/

rang srog= lhug ma ṇi dbyangs gsal btags pa brgya/ las bum du hya gṝ wa brgya/ oṃ a āḥ ka kha ga gha nga= yig brgya/ ye dhar= shra ma ṇa 'grub par gyur cig swa hā ཿ gsum/ mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mang*/ mchod rol bzhi/ hrīḥ khyad par rmad byung= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ rkang*/ bstod pa/ rigs lnga spyi phyag yig brgya shar tshogs grol/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba= na raka skong bshags cha tshang*/ yig brgya brgya/ zhi rol lnga/ mar me'i smon lam bcas/ tshaugs zhus/ thing gcig rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ tshogs byin rlabs/ sum gnyis/ spyan 'dren/ 'jam rol/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ sum gnyis/ mchod pa/ sum gnyis/ rgya/ dung*/ bar bshags/ 'jam rol/ bzhag 'di la nam yang kha 'bud med/ na mo/ rig 'dzin= khyad par 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i= 'gugs rol/ rkang*/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ tshogs/ bsgral bstab/ phaṭaḥ rkang*/ dung*/ 'jam rol bzhag skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ na moḥ bde gshegs= bhyo bi shwo= gsum/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃḥ thing gsum/ sil/ rkang*/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ (533)āḥ rang byung= rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la skyolaḥ sum gnyis/ rgya/ dung*/ skong bshags 'dod rgu lhun grub/ hrīḥ nub phyogs= sdug bsngal rang grol lha tshogs thugs dam bskangaḥ rigs bdag 'chi med mgon po'i= tshig rkang bdun tsho bzhi kar byar/ rgyas par mdzodaḥ sum gnyis/ rgya/ dung*/ mdor na rab 'byams= gnam phud theb nang bshams nas mchod mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ tshogs drang ba/ bdag 'jug rgyas pa la/ ji ltar= khrus gdangs/ las rdor pas/ las bum sgros bran/ tshogs pa bskor/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwo badzra= zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ slob dpon gyis yungs thun brab/ las rdor pas gu gul 'grim/ maṇḍal 'thor nas 'gyed/ sa gzhi spos chus= a khaṃ= me tog bzung*/ 'bru gsum/ mig dar bzhes/ kun mkhyen ye shes= khrus gdangs/ lan phyi ma gnyis lhug rdo rje slob dpon=

khrus gdangs/ phyi ma gnyis lhug thugs rje chen po= khrus gdangs/ phyi ma gnyis lhug sa ma ya pra be= gcig oṃ na ma= tsho gsum/ chon bzhi/ dkyil 'khor gyi= ma ṇi= a be= zhi rol/ brgyud gsum/ dang po gsum par rkang*/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ las rdor g.yab dar/ spos snod thogs pas dkyil 'khor tshogs pa bskor/ pra titstsha= la/ nas thal mo'i bar dkram pra ti ghṛ hṇa= spyi bor blugs/ hoḥ bde gshegs snying po= khrus gdangs/ rdo rjes mig dar dbye/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas= hūm̐ḥ bkra shis bum pa=(534) bum gdangs/ slob dpon gyis rnam bum/ gzhan rnams kyis rdo rje gsor/ sngags la dril bsil/ bum chu myang*/ dpe lus dang= hūm̐ḥ yab yum sbyor ba'i= dbang gdangs chung ba/ rdor sems ltar/ slob dpon gyis gsang thod len/ gzhan rnams thod rgyang*/ hūm̐ḥ chos rnam= dbang gdangs/ slob dpon rig tsaka dang*/ gzhan rnams dril bur sor rtser sbyar/ sngags la/ dril bsil dang 'khyud rgya/ hoḥ ka dag= dbang gdangs chung ba/ slob dpon me long*/ man shel/ gzhan rnams rdo rjer phyar/ sngags la dril bsil/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs= khrus gdangs/ sa gzhi= gtso bos= khrus gdangs/ spyad du gsol/ dros tshogs grol/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus= lhag zhus/ byin rlabs/ thing gcig dung*/ ḍā/ sil/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ dkyil 'khor= mthar sum gcig sil/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ phyi chog gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ mchod rlabs/ yo ga zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā/ lha bskyed yo ga bzhi dril/ spyan 'dren/ thugs thig rol/ bzhugs phyag mchod pa gdangs/ rol cig= khyad par= yo ga dril stabs/ bstod pa yo ga spyi phyag phaṭaḥdzaḥ bsnyen dmigs lhug ma ṇi rigs bzhi bsnyen/ las sbyor/ bum sgrub/ mchod pa/ hrīḥ kun tu= zhi rol/ ḍā/ bstod pa/ 'od zhu/ dwangs chen grol/ gsol ka yongs rdzogs/ na rag skong bshags/ bar tshogs grol/ yo ga bzhi dril kho nas/ tshogs zhus/ tshogs byin rlabs/

zhi rol/ spyan 'dren/ zhi rol/ rkang*/ ḍā/ mchod pa zhi (535) rol/ rkang*/ ḍā/ bar bshags/ nṛ tri badzra= bsgral bstab/ zhi rol/ rkang*/ gzhung*/ bhyo bi sho= hrīḥ nub phyogs= rgyas par mdzodaḥ zhi rol/ bdag 'jug bsdus pa rdor sems ltar/ oṃ badzra= ye shes rgyal po= oṃ badzra= gsum/ oṃḥ rdo rje'i ye shes= 'jug par 'tshalaḥ gnas 'dren/ yo ga bzhi dril kho nas/ hrīḥ bdag nyid= na moḥ mchog gsum= gsum/ hrīḥ 'dir snang= tiṣṭhantuḥ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ sarba bighāṃ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bhyo= gsum/ thams cad kyis rdor dril bcas/ pad skor/ se gol bcas/ las rdor pas rtse zhwa gyon bzhin/ zhi sbyong ming byang la g.yas bskor gsum/ g.yon bskor gcig bzed zhal du bzhag suṃ bha ni= gsum la thams cad kyis/ rdor bskor gsum/ nang 'dren gcig dril ring dkrol/ mchod dpon nas ting lo chang bu gcig g.yon bskor gsum/ g.yas bskor gcig bzed zhal du gzhag hrīḥ 'khor bar= 535) yo ga bzhi dril lan gcig sum bha ni= gcig la rdor bskor/ dril bsil snga ma ltar/ las rdor pas gzhi mdun padma 'dab drug la sa bon drug dgod/ dbus su gtso bum gzhag mtshams rigs drug gtor ma bsham/ de mdun byang chas ming byang bshams pa/ de mdun bzhengs te gnas pa rang mal bzed zhal du/ zhi sbyong drag sbyong phyogs gcig yod pas phyir nur bzhin gzhi dang sgo gnyis bar tsam du g.yon bskor gsum/ g.yas bskor gcig thang la gzhag hrīḥ 'khor ba= lan gcig sum bha ni= 536) dus phyir nur bzhin/ g.yon bskor gsum/ g.yas bskor gcig bcas/ slar sgo them steng du bzhag hrīḥ 'khor ba= lan gcig sum bha ni= zhi rol dung*/ rkang dus phyir dor/ hoḥ skyabs gnas= dang*/ hūm̐ḥ nyon cig= yo ga bzhi dril/ las rdor/ dkyil 'khor mdun khrus dar/ lag g.yon steng me long*/ g.yas pas las bum/ mdun du khrus gzhong 'jog bzhin/ khrus kyi khang pa= khrus gdangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa=

lha khrul rol mo/ rgya dkar/ (Musical notes and signs here) yo ga bzhi dril gyis/ ji ltar= phyed rol/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung= phyed rol/ kun bzang rdor sems= rol/ rnam dag sku mnga'= rol/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad= rol/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na= rol/ mgon po klu sgrub= rol/ ma bcos spros bral= rol/ yang dag 'jam dpal= rol/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin= rol/ gang gi 'phrul dang= rol/ gang sngon sbyin pa= rol/ 'di ni khrus mchog= rol/ de dag sku la= oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī āḥ las bum sgro'i rting pas me long steng tshom bu lnga dgod/ kā ya bi shwa= khrus ras kyis phyi tshul bya/ de nas de la= na bza'= gos bzang= rgyan mchog= 'phags pa= 'jig rten= sna tshogs= gang la= gos bzang= bzod pa= oṃ badzra wast+ra= khrus chu slar las bum du blugs pa'i ming byang la khrus bya ba ni/ 'di ni dbyings rig= sngags la dug khrus/ rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) pad bskor/ (Musical notes and signs here) bzhi rdeb yod pa yin/ 'di ni lhun grub= rol de ltar/ 'di ni ka dag= rol gong bzhin/ 337) sa chu me rlung rnams kyis ming byang la brab cing*/ ma rig= sngags/ dril bsil/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ gtor ma rnams bsang chus bran/ hūm̐/ 'dod pa'i= dmyal ba'i thub gtor/ g.yas bskor gsum/ g.yon bskor gcig bzed zhal du dor/ zhe sdang rnam dag= dmyal ba'i thub pas dbang bskur/ nyon cig= byang bu yi dwags dal du spo/ dmyal ba'i sa bon bsal/ rigs drug la des 'gres rdzogs nas/ byang bu slob dpon mdun/ padma 'dab brgyad khar dgod/ mi dar me tog bla mas gnang*/ oṃḥrang snang rnam dag= dus las rdor gyis byang bu 'degs bzhin/ hūm̐ḥ don gyi 'og min= dus dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir bskor ba gcig byas nas/ slar slob dpon mdun dgod/ byin 'bebs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā dus/ spos bskor/ tiṣṭha badzra= dus/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje byang bu'i mgor gzhag

hūm̐/ rten 'brel dus= las rdor gyis byang bub kyags/ me tog slob dpon mdun 'grim dkyil du dor/ mig dar slob dpon gyis dbye/ lha ngo slob dpon gyis bstan/ gtso bum slob dpon la phul/ hūm̐ḥ phyi ltar bum pa= dbang gdangs che 'bring chung gsum gang rigs/ yig drug sngags byang slob dpon la phul nas dbang bskur la/ thub dbang slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rjes dbang bskur/ mdun du rin po che= dus zas bsngo rnams la chu gtsang bran/ hūm̐/ kha zas= dus las rdor pas bkyags la phyi rol du dri gsur gtang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i= nas/ thams cad nam mkha'i= bar/ zhi khro nas/ hūm̐/ phung khams= dus byang bu las rdor pas btegs/ hūm̐/ ye shes= dus slob dpon 338) gyis mar me btegs la gzhag byang bu slob dpon mdun gzhag hūm̐ḥ tshe 'das= 'dres par gyur/ bla mas/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥphaṭaḥ gsum gsung*/ slob dpon la dpal 'bar phul/ las rdor pas byang bu shog rkyang thur ma'i rtser bsgron pa/ bzed zhal stong pa'i steng gzung*/ yongs grub shog ma ṇi/ pi pu la= yig brgya sogs brjod/ zhi rol/ dung*/ rgya/ dkar/ byang bu bsregs pa'i byang ro steng / gtso bum chu dang sngags byes brab/ bde smon rdul bral ma/ tshogs drang ba/ cha gsum/ tshogs grol/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus= lhag zhus/ byin rlabs/ zhi rol/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ lhag ma thugs thig ltar/ zhi rol/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ rkang*/ gsol ka bkyag rgyu man rig 'dus dang 'dra'o/ dmigs bsal bskul pa/ hūm̐ḥ bzhengs shig= tshig 'go len ma thag nas rkang lnga 'bud srol yod// dge'o//
